candidate_thresholds.name: P95 Percentile
candidate_thresholds.policy: Tolerates 5% false alarm in validation. Aggressive.

candidate_thresholds.name: Normal Maximum
candidate_thresholds.policy: Strict zero FP on validation set. Zero-margin boundary.

candidate_thresholds.name: Mean + 3σ (Conservative MVP)
candidate_thresholds.policy: 99.7% Gaussian confidence interval. Robust safety margin against normal noise.

calibration.selection_rationale: Conservative MVP zero-FP criterion: max(Max + 0.05, Mean + 3σ).
statistical_limitations: Small sample size (N=29) limits empirical percentile estimation accuracy (P99 is interpolated between top 2 samples).
Normal distribution assumption for μ+3σ is an approximation; empirical distance distribution may exhibit mild skewness.
Threshold does not account for unseen factory lighting fluctuations; image quality warnings must supplement decision confidence.
